scope: Static text-free original artwork, not finished Reel verification
reviewer: assistant visual inspection, not user adoption or a signed release
method: Inspected each generated original as returned by imagegen and the numbered overview containing seven 360x640 static previews at original contact-sheet resolution.

checks.storySequence: Observed setup, overpacking, full picnic setup, missing fish, realization and noodle payoff in the selected order.
checks.characterIdentity: v18 refrigerator-head identity, viewer-left mint handle/pineapple, viewer-right hinges, chef hat, compact apron, mittens and shoes checked visually.
checks.relationship: Practical skeptical reactions and comic bickering; no romantic action, heart effects or feeding each other.
checks.continuity: Woman identity/clothing, wagon, mustard cooler, table, mat, chairs, thermos and late-scene contents compared; targeted imagegen corrections retained as separate candidates.
checks.textSeparation: No dialogue or balloons generated. Checklist has empty boxes only. Text and brand remain future separate layers.
checks.scopeBoundary: No app UI or unverified product feature depicted.

scenes.notes: Large luggage silhouette and skeptical woman read clearly. Reframed r2 preserves compact Jango and adds hat clearance; speaker and phone stand deferred to scene 3.
Clipboard with three empty boxes, compact apron and connected mittens. Woman open-palm skepticism. Human left arm framing is intentional medium-shot crop.
Single speaker and folded stand are inserted, woman holds doorway. Compact body and two mitten connections preserved. Hat is near the right edge; future zoom anchor must protect it.

Wide setting establishes the practical camp. Closed cooler, exactly two empty plates, two deployed chairs and one spread mat. r2 removes duplicate packed chairs/mat from wagon. Jango uses the established open speaking smile instead of the initially proposed closed smile; no new mouth anatomy.

Large clear cooler reveal: two flat blue ice packs, red sauce, dark sauce and whole perilla leaves, no fish. Jango flat mouth and sweat drop, woman questioning. Close camera naturally occludes lower bodies; complete hat is retained.

Sheepish Jango and arms-folded woman clearly contrast scene 4. r2 matches the two flat ice packs and whole perilla leaves to scene 5. Generated small sad-arc mouth was retained as a clear established embarrassed expression rather than forcing the proposed flat line.
Two noodle cups and thermos provide the payoff. Woman looks unimpressed, Jango content. r2 removes the third empty foreground chair and reduces plates to two. Two occupied chairs remain.

deferred: Artwork adoption by the user after viewing these candidates.

1080x1920 final output and 100-to-103% motion: generated originals are 941x1672, 0.0532% wider than exact 9:16; preserve source bytes and aspect ratio. Do not stretch. Final movement and any framing correction must be reviewed before render.

Scenes 2–3 have hats close to the right edge and scene 5 is an intentional close shot. Use safe zoom anchoring or imagegen background expansion if needed. Static review does not establish motion safety.
Korean dialogue, bubble tails, timing, final CTA and checklist text are not present yet; review after separate typesetting.
